\chapter{Methodology}
\label{sec:methodology}

We fine-tune each encoder on the classification task using a linear head over
the \texttt{[CLS]} representation, trained with a learning rate of \num{2e-5}
for \SI{3}{epochs}. Predictions are obtained as
\begin{equation}
  \hat{y} = \argmax_{c} \softmax(\vec{W}\vec{h} + \vec{b})_c ,
  \label{eq:prediction}
\end{equation}
where $\vec{h}$ is the final hidden state. Baseline results are reported in
\cref{tab:baselines}.

\begin{table}[t]
  \centering
  \caption{Baseline results on the development set.}
  \label{tab:baselines}

\end{table}
